g.text: Lab 01: Contract-First API Architecture & Execution Topology
Single Source of Truth: OpenAPI 3.0 Contract • Poridhi LB • Write Idempotency • Cursor Pagination • RFC 7807
Step-by-step trace of how mutations, paginated queries, and error responses flow through the single source of truth
• Appends to ordersDb with auto ID (126)
If a network drop occurs and the client retries with the
same UUID key, duplicate order creation is blocked.
No duplicate items when new orders arrive, and
eliminates slow OFFSET table scans in production SQL.
Replaces ad-hoc proprietary error structures with a
globally standard format for frontend error handling.
